_about: Invented for the Familiar demo: the record series of the islands that could hold the Ferrolho and Calhau families. A series is one kind of record for one place over a run of years.

series.title: Baptisms of Ponta do Moinho
series.holder: Invented diocesan archive of Ilha Vaqueira, books 3-6
series.note: Books 1896-1897 were lost before filming; the archive keeps a later copy.
